SIGNALS.name: levent
SIGNALS.summary: Levent Alpöge says an internal Claude research model found the core algorithm for a new paper on 16 October, using 14M output tokens with no human input, and Anthropic researchers helped polish the paper.

SIGNALS.name: Lance Fortnow
SIGNALS.summary: Complexity theorist Lance Fortnow notes OpenAI's claim that the Exponential Time Hypothesis is false: 3SAT solvable in 2^{o(n)} time, with a Lean formalization of the proof.

SIGNALS.name: Lech Mazur
SIGNALS.summary: Says OpenAI's new results would resolve six entries in ProofAtlas's Top 500 open problems and notes partial progress on Yang-Mills existence and mass gap.

SIGNALS.name: Andrew Curran
SIGNALS.summary: Summarizes OpenAI's three announced discoveries: local smoothing and the Kakeya conjecture, the Exponential Time Hypothesis being false, and existence of quantum chromodynamics.

SIGNALS.name: Dan Roberts
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI's Dan Roberts announces three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics, covering harmonic analysis, complexity theory and quantum field theory.

SIGNALS.name: Min Choi
SIGNALS.summary: Reports that Anthropic filed for its IPO, planning to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, with the IPO price and date still to be determined.

SIGNALS.name: IndiaAI
SIGNALS.summary: IndiaAI says its Cohort II wrapped up in August 2026, with 10 high-growth startups already past 16.7M euros in global funding.

SIGNALS.name: Wall St Engine
SIGNALS.summary: Reports Nvidia and TCV joined an extension of Higgsfield's Series B, following its $400 million raise at a $5.4 billion valuation in August.
